column1: # How disk cleanup recognizes a running test process. Format: label<TAB>ERE.
# Each pattern is checked against one command line with a space appended, so a
# trailing [ ] means "end of word". Patterns start at the executable, so a shell
# or an agent whose arguments merely mention a test runner does not match; the real
# runner it starts does. Vectors: test-lane-vectors.tsv.
